blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: TR90 的 27 篇參考文獻可依主題分為幾大類別：
blocks.en: The 27 references in TR90 can be grouped into several thematic categories:

blocks.zh: 品質風險管理 (Quality Risk Management, QRM)：ICH Q9 (Ref. 3) 是整個 CCS 的方法論基礎，提供風險評估、風險控制與風險審查的系統化框架。
blocks.en: Quality risk management (QRM): ICH Q9 (Ref. 3) is the methodological foundation of the entire CCS, providing a systematic framework for risk assessment, risk control and risk review.

blocks.zh: 微生物/病毒控制：USP <1072> (Ref. 1) 處理消毒劑；USP <85> (Ref. 6) 處理內毒素；PDA TR71 (Ref. 8) 與 TR83 (Ref. 9) 處理病毒偵測與污染；USP <63> (Ref. 17) 處理黴漿菌。
blocks.en: Microbial/viral control: USP <1072> (Ref. 1) addresses disinfectants; USP <85> (Ref. 6) addresses endotoxin; PDA TR71 (Ref. 8) and TR83 (Ref. 9) address virus detection and contamination; USP <63> (Ref. 17) addresses mycoplasma.

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性 (Container Closure Integrity, CCI)：Ref. 12-13, 19-26 涵蓋了從可見微粒、包裝完整性測試到密封力量評估的完整範疇。這反映了 CCS 對「產品保護」的高度重視。
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI): Ref. 12-13 and 19-26 cover the full scope from visible particulates and package integrity testing to seal force evaluation. This reflects the strong emphasis the CCS places on product protection.

blocks.zh: 滅菌與製程確效：PDA TR61 (Ref. 2) 處理 SIP；ISO 11137 (Ref. 10) 處理輻射滅菌劑量；FDA Parametric Release 指引 (Ref. 11) 處理終端滅菌的參數放行。
blocks.en: Sterilization and process validation: PDA TR61 (Ref. 2) addresses SIP; ISO 11137 (Ref. 10) addresses radiation sterilization dose; the FDA Parametric Release guidance (Ref. 11) addresses parametric release of terminally sterilized products.

blocks.zh: 細胞治療/生物製劑：PDA TR81 (Ref. 15) 與 Cundell (Ref. 18) 特別針對細胞治療產品的微生物控制策略，反映了 TR90 對先進療法的關注。
blocks.en: Cell therapy/biologics: PDA TR81 (Ref. 15) and Cundell (Ref. 18) specifically address microbial control strategies for cell therapy products, reflecting TR90's attention to advanced therapies.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 參考文獻就像是CCS 這棟大樓的建築規範與施工手冊。ICH Q9 是最上位的「建築法規」，定義了風險管理的基本原則；各項 PDA 技術報告則是各工種的「施工規範」（消毒、滅菌、容器密封、環境監控等）；而期刊論文則是「工程案例報告」，分享實際施工中遇到的問題與解決方案。建造 CCS 這棟大樓時，你不需要背誦所有規範，但必須知道在遇到特定問題時該查閱哪一本手冊。
blocks.en: The references are like the building codes and construction manuals for the "building" that is the CCS. ICH Q9 is the top-level "building code" that defines the basic principles of risk management; the PDA technical reports are the "construction specifications" for each trade (disinfection, sterilization, container closure, environmental monitoring, etc.); and journal articles are the "engineering case reports" that share problems met and solutions found on real job sites. When building the CCS, you do not need to memorize every specification, but you must know which manual to consult when a particular problem arises.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性 (CCI) 的高占比：27 篇參考文獻中，有將近三分之一（Ref. 12-13, 19-26）與容器密封系統相關。這充分說明在 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的框架下，CCI 已從傳統的「品質控制項目」提升為 CCS 的核心組成部分。對於無菌產品而言，再好的無菌製程都無法彌補容器密封失敗帶來的風險。
blocks.en: The high share of container closure integrity (CCI): Nearly one third of the 27 references (Ref. 12-13, 19-26) relate to container closure systems. This shows that under the EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) framework, CCI has moved from a traditional "quality control item" to a core component of the CCS. For a sterile product, even the best aseptic process cannot make up for the risk created by a container closure failure.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 的基石地位：幾乎所有 CCS 的風險評估活動都以 ICH Q9 為方法論依據。2023 年發布的 Q9(R1) 修訂版進一步強化了「基於風險的決策」概念，值得額外關注。
blocks.en: The cornerstone role of ICH Q9: Almost all CCS risk assessment activities use ICH Q9 as their methodological basis. The Q9(R1) revision, issued in 2023, further strengthens the concept of "risk-based decision-making" and deserves extra attention.

blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你負責建立一個新的無菌注射劑 CCS，在這 27 篇參考文獻中，你會優先閱讀哪 5 篇？為什麼？
blocks.en: If you were responsible for establishing a CCS for a new sterile injectable, which 5 of these 27 references would you read first, and why?

blocks.zh: 對於細胞治療產品的 CCS，哪些參考文獻特別重要？它們處理的風險與傳統小分子注射劑有何不同？
blocks.en: For the CCS of a cell therapy product, which references are especially important? How do the risks they address differ from those of a conventional small-molecule injectable?

blocks.zh: 14.0 Relevant Guidance Documents 14.0 相關指引文件
blocks.en: 14.0 Relevant Guidance Documents

blocks.zh: 三層文獻架構：TR90 的參考文獻體系可以理解為三個同心圓層次：
blocks.en: Three-layer literature structure: The reference system in TR90 can be understood as three concentric layers:

blocks.zh: 最外層 -- 法規指引 (Regulatory Guidance)：ICH Q 系列、EU GMP Annex 1、FDA Guidance 等。這些是「必須遵守」的法規期待，定義了 CCS 的合規底線。
blocks.en: Outermost layer -- Regulatory Guidance: the ICH Q series, EU GMP Annex 1, FDA guidance, etc. These are the "must comply" regulatory expectations and define the compliance baseline for the CCS.

blocks.zh: 中間層 -- 行業標準 (Industry Standards)：ISO 標準、USP 通則等。這些提供了具體的技術方法與接受標準，是將法規要求轉化為可操作程序的橋梁。
blocks.en: Middle layer -- Industry Standards: ISO standards, USP general chapters, etc. These provide concrete technical methods and acceptance criteria, and are the bridge that turns regulatory requirements into workable procedures.

blocks.zh: 最內層 -- 技術指引 (Technical Guidance)：PDA 技術報告與 Points to Consider。這些是行業專家的共識，提供最詳細的「How-to」指引，幫助企業實際建立和維護 CCS。
blocks.en: Innermost layer -- Technical Guidance: PDA technical reports and Points to Consider. These reflect industry expert consensus and give the most detailed "how-to" guidance to help companies actually establish and maintain a CCS.

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位建築師要設計一棟符合法規的建築。ICH Q 系列與 EU GMP Annex 1 就像是「建築法」，告訴你必須滿足什麼標準（如耐震係數、消防規範）。ISO 標準與 USP 通則 就像是「建築材料規範」與「施工標準」，告訴你混凝土強度要多少、鋼筋間距要多大。PDA 技術報告 則像是「建築師手冊」和「工程案例集」，分享其他建築師在類似專案中的設計經驗與最佳實務。三者缺一不可，但使用時機不同：法規是「必須做到」，標準是「怎麼衡量」，技術報告是「怎麼做到」。
blocks.en: Imagine you are an architect designing a building that must meet regulations. The ICH Q series and EU GMP Annex 1 are like the "building law", telling you which standards must be met (such as seismic coefficients and fire codes). ISO standards and USP general chapters are like the "building material specifications" and "construction standards", telling you how strong the concrete must be and how far apart the rebar must be spaced. PDA technical reports are like the "architect's handbook" and "collection of project case studies", sharing the design experience and best practices of other architects on similar projects. You need all three, but they are used at different times: regulations tell you what you "must achieve", standards tell you "how to measure", and technical reports tell you "how to do it".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 ICH Q 系列在 CCS 中的角色
blocks.en: Key Notes: Role of the ICH Q Series in the CCS

blocks.zh: TR90 列出了 6 項 ICH 指引，它們構成了 CCS 的品質管理骨架：
blocks.en: TR90 lists 6 ICH guidelines, which form the quality management backbone of the CCS:

blocks.zh: Q5A(R1) -- 病毒安全：對於生物製劑的 CCS，病毒清除/去活化是核心污染控制之一。
blocks.en: Q5A(R1) -- Viral safety: For the CCS of a biologic, viral clearance/inactivation is one of the core contamination controls.

blocks.zh: Q6A -- 規格標準：定義藥物的測試方法與接受標準，CCS 中的「什麼算合格」由此而來。
blocks.en: Q6A -- Specifications: Defines test methods and acceptance criteria for drug products; the CCS's definition of "what counts as acceptable" comes from here.

blocks.zh: Q7 -- API GMP：原料藥的 GMP 要求，CCS 需要從原料端就開始管控污染。
blocks.en: Q7 -- GMP for APIs: GMP requirements for active pharmaceutical ingredients; the CCS needs to control contamination starting from the raw material end.

blocks.zh: Q8(R2) -- 藥品開發：Quality by Design (QbD) 的理論基礎，CCS 應在產品開發階段就被設計進去。
blocks.en: Q8(R2) -- Pharmaceutical development: The theoretical basis of Quality by Design (QbD); the CCS should be designed in already at the product development stage.

blocks.zh: Q9 -- 品質風險管理：CCS 所有風險評估的方法論核心。
blocks.en: Q9 -- Quality risk management: The methodological core of all CCS risk assessments.

blocks.zh: Q10 -- 藥品品質系統：CCS 運作的品質系統框架，涵蓋 CAPA、變更管制、管理審查等。
blocks.en: Q10 -- Pharmaceutical quality system: The quality system framework within which the CCS operates, covering CAPA, change control, management review, etc.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 如何使用這份文獻清單：
blocks.en: How to use this reference list:

blocks.zh: 新建 CCS 時：從 ICH Q9（風險管理方法論）和 EU GMP Annex 1（法規要求框架）開始，建立 CCS 的整體架構。然後依據產品類型（小分子/生物製劑/細胞治療），選擇對應的 PDA 技術報告深入各子系統。
blocks.en: When building a new CCS: Start with ICH Q9 (risk management methodology) and EU GMP Annex 1 (regulatory requirements framework) to establish the overall architecture of the CCS. Then, according to product type (small molecule/biologic/cell therapy), select the corresponding PDA technical reports to go deeper into each subsystem.

blocks.zh: 稽核準備時：確認你的 CCS 文件中引用了與你的製程相關的法規指引。稽核員會期望看到你參考了最新版本的適用法規。
blocks.en: When preparing for an audit: Confirm that your CCS documents cite the regulatory guidance relevant to your process. Auditors will expect to see that you have referred to the latest versions of the applicable regulations.

blocks.zh: 問題排查時：當遇到特定技術問題（如滅菌確效失敗、環境監控趨勢異常、容器密封性問題），直接查閱對應主題的 PDA 技術報告，通常能找到問題排查的思路與解決方案。
blocks.en: When troubleshooting: When you meet a specific technical problem (such as a sterilization validation failure, an adverse environmental monitoring trend or a container closure integrity issue), go directly to the PDA technical report on that topic; it will usually offer ideas for troubleshooting and solutions.

blocks.zh: 持續改善時：定期檢查是否有新版法規或技術報告發布。例如 ICH Q9(R1) 已於 2023 年發布，EU GMP Annex 1 於 2023 年 8 月正式生效 -- CCS 應隨之更新。
blocks.en: When driving continual improvement: Periodically check whether new versions of regulations or technical reports have been published. For example, ICH Q9(R1) was issued in 2023 and EU GMP Annex 1 formally came into effect in August 2023 -- the CCS should be updated accordingly.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前的 CCS 文件中引用了哪些法規與行業指引？是否涵蓋了 TR90 列出的所有相關文件？
blocks.en: Which regulatory and industry guidance documents are cited in your site's current CCS documents? Do they cover all the relevant documents listed in TR90?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 接到一個新的細胞治療 (Cell Therapy) 產品案子，你需要額外參考哪些 TR90 列出的文獻來補充現有 CCS？
blocks.en: If your CDMO takes on a new cell therapy product, which additional references listed in TR90 would you need to supplement your existing CCS?

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 與 FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004) 之間有哪些主要差異？這些差異如何影響你的 CCS 設計？
blocks.en: What are the main differences between EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) and the FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004)? How do these differences affect your CCS design?

blocks.zh: PDA TR13（環境監控）在 2022 年進行了修訂。請思考：修訂版中可能加入了哪些與 Annex 1 (2022) 對齊的新要求？
blocks.en: PDA TR13 (environmental monitoring) was revised in 2022. Consider: what new requirements aligned with Annex 1 (2022) might the revised version have added?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 PDA 技術報告分類導覽
blocks.en: Key Notes: Guide to PDA Technical Report Categories

blocks.zh: 28 份 PDA 技術出版品可依 CCS 主題分為以下類別：
blocks.en: The 28 PDA technical publications can be divided into the following categories by CCS topic:

blocks.zh: 建議：當你的 CCS 中需要處理某一特定主題時，先查閱對應的 PDA 技術報告，它通常能提供最實用的操作指引。
blocks.en: Recommendation: When your CCS needs to address a specific topic, first consult the corresponding PDA technical report; it usually provides the most practical operational guidance.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 美歐法規指引對照
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Comparison of US and EU Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: TR90 同時引用了美國 FDA 與歐洲 EMA/EU GMP 的指引，反映了 CCS 必須滿足全球多重法規的現實：
blocks.en: TR90 cites guidance from both the US FDA and the European EMA/EU GMP, reflecting the reality that a CCS must satisfy multiple regulatory regimes worldwide:

blocks.zh: 對於同時供應美國與歐洲市場的 CDMO 而言，CCS 必須同時滿足兩套法規的要求，通常以較嚴格者為基準。
blocks.en: For a CDMO supplying both the US and European markets, the CCS must satisfy both sets of requirements, usually taking the stricter one as the baseline.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: TR90 引用了 27 篇核心參考文獻，涵蓋風險管理、微生物控制、容器密封完整性、滅菌確效與細胞治療等主題
blocks.en: TR90 cites 27 core references covering risk management, microbial control, container closure integrity, sterilization validation and cell therapy, among other topics

blocks.zh: 相關指引文件分為三層：法規指引（ICH/FDA/EMA）定義合規底線、行業標準（ISO/USP）提供技術方法、PDA 技術報告提供實務操作指引
blocks.en: The relevant guidance documents fall into three layers: regulatory guidance (ICH/FDA/EMA) defines the compliance baseline, industry standards (ISO/USP) provide technical methods, and PDA technical reports provide practical operating guidance

blocks.zh: 28 份 PDA 技術出版品覆蓋了 CCS 的所有核心子系統，是建立與維護 CCS 的最佳「How-to」資源
blocks.en: The 28 PDA technical publications cover all core subsystems of the CCS and are the best "how-to" resource for establishing and maintaining a CCS

blocks.zh: 國際（ICH/ISO）、美國（FDA/USP）與歐洲（EMA/EU GMP）三大法規體系的指引需同步參考，尤其對跨國供應的 CDMO 至關重要
blocks.en: The guidance of the three regulatory systems, international (ICH/ISO), US (FDA/USP) and European (EMA/EU GMP), should be consulted together, which is especially important for CDMOs supplying multiple regions

blocks.zh: CCS 文件應定期更新所引用的法規版本，確保與最新法規期待保持一致
blocks.en: CCS documents should regularly update the regulatory versions they cite to stay aligned with the latest regulatory expectations
